text.p: Investors had oversubscribed for the two-million-share large investor tranche of Polish construction company Mostostal Zabrze SA's 2.6 million new share issue, the company's spokesman said.
Piotr Grabowski told Reuters the subscription for the small investor tranche of 600,000-shares would end on Friday and the results were not yet known.
"There is an oversubscription in the large investor tranche," he said, adding there were both foreign and Polish investors who subscribed for the shares.
He declined to give any details and said full results of the offer would be released on Monday.

Grabowski also said the company would allot the shares by the end of next week. He said that in the large investor tranche investors who took part in the book-building process and current shareholders would be preferred.
The shares were priced at 9.75 zlotys per share.
